newsitem.title: USA: CBOE names Wilkinson director, Ascher assumes post.
newsitem.headline: CBOE names Wilkinson director, Ascher assumes post.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Wednesday its board of directors named Alvin Wilkinson to complete the final year of a three-year term for on-floor director.
The position was vacated by William Floersch.
Wilkinson is president of CIT Management Group Inc.
The exchange also said Thomas Ascher, an independent market maker, assumed his post of CBOE vice chairman and chairman of the executive committee.
Ascher was selected in December to replace Floersch, who had served six terms as vice chairman.
CBOE Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Alger Chapman also re-appointed Leon Kendall and Duane Kullberg to two-year terms as two of the four public directors on the board.

Kendall is professor of finance and real estate at Northwestern University's Kellogg Graduate School of Management and Kullberg is a retired managing partner and chief executive officer of Arthur Andersen & Co S.C.
